description: one row per reference: scopes, rules, label groups, then (labels only) the workload count

rule.description: rule: its position in the ruleset as the TUI's Policy screen lists it, from 1

pending.description: a change not provisioned: the rule, its ruleset or the group has an update_type

disabled.description: the rule or its ruleset is disabled

via.description: the label group it is reached through, when not named directly

count.description: workloads: how many workloads carry the label

exact.description: workloads: false when count is a lower bound (at least)

href.description: the rule's, the ruleset's (scope), the group's, or the label's (workloads)
